label: Commodity relative momentum
desc: Rank 41 commodities on past returns over five formation windows; long the strongest, short the weakest. The sleeve that pairs with trend.
rule: five formation windows · rank within commodities · long/short tails · 10% target
config:
xs_momentum_commodities:
  asset_classes:
  - futures
  universe_filters:
  - type: PrimaryOnly
  - type: StaticUniverse
    params:
      symbols:
      - AFB
      - AWM
      - CC
      - CL
      - CO
      - CT
      - DC
      - EUA
      - FC
      - GC
      - GD
      - HG
      - HO
      - KC
      - KW
      - LB
      - LCC
      - LE
      - LH
      - LRC
      - LSU
      - LWB
      - MW
      - NBP
      - NG
      - OJ
      - PA
      - PL
      - QS
      - RB
      - RS
      - SB
      - SI
      - WBS
      - ZC
      - ZL
      - ZM
      - ZO
      - ZR
      - ZS
      - ZW
  - type: HistoryFilter
    params:
      min_days: 252
  - type: DataIntegrityFilter
  - type: LiquidityFilter
    params:
      min_volume: 100
      lookback: 63
  vol_normalizer:
    type: Identity
  signals:
  - type: CrossSectionalSignal
    weight: 1.0
    params:
      vol_estimator:
        type: EWMA2
        params:
          span: 32
      indicator:
        type: CumulativeReturn
        params:
          lookback: 252
          skip: 0
      ranker:
        type: PercentileRank
        params:
          min_names: 15
      position_function:
        type: QuantilePortfolio
        params:
          long_pct: 0.3
          short_pct: 0.3
          weighting: equal
          dollar_neutral: true
      risk_weighting:
        type: InverseVol
        params:
          target_vol: 0.15
          floor: 0.08
  asset_allocator:
    type: Identity
  model_gearing:
    type: XSVolTarget
    params:
      target_vol: 0.1
      vol_lookback: 63
      leverage_cap: 3.0
  cost_model:
    type: FixedBPS
    params:
      cost_bps: 3.0
  rebalance: daily
  position_smoothing: 10
